question: Lists by ID all Creature-type cards with legal status.
evidence: legal status refer to status = 'legal'; Goblin-type cards refer to types = 'Creature';
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching rulings record.
gold: SELECT T1.id FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T1.uuid = T3.uuid WHERE T3.status = 'Legal' AND T1.types = 'Creature'
gold0: SELECT T1.id FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T1.uuid = T3.uuid WHERE T3.status = 'Legal' AND T1.types = 'Creature'

c.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM cards AS c JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.types = 'Creature' AND l.status = 'legal' ORDER BY c.id;

d.request: List the IDs of all Creature-type cards with legal status, including cards that have no matching rulings record.
d.sql: SELECT c.id FROM cards AS c WHERE c.types LIKE '%Creature%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalities AS l WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid AND l.status = 'Legal')

b.request: List the IDs of cards whose types include Creature and whose legality status is 'legal', including cards with no matching rulings record
b.sql: SELECT c.id FROM cards AS c WHERE c.types LIKE '%Creature%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalities AS l WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid AND l.status = 'legal');
